verdict.rationale: Vue provides an official 'Migration from Vue 2' guide plus a dedicated Vue 2 EOL/security-updates page, both documented on vuejs.org, giving developers a clear official path to upgrade major versions. Community comments corroborate that past major transitions (e.g., Vue 3 rewrite) were well received. Missing for 10: independent hands-on account of actually following the guide end-to-end and any migration tooling/codemods beyond the doc pages.
